additions.name: Kai Shin Satsumasendai AI Data Center — commercial campus

status.summary: Kai Shin plans a commercial AI data-centre campus at Circular Park Kyushu, on the former Sendai thermal power station property in Satsumasendai. The July 18, 2026 location agreement outlines staged expansion from an initial pilot to a proposed 350 MW. The prefecture reports a March 2033 target and estimates investment of about JPY 850 billion at that scale, subject to change. The city reported continuing development preparations on October 8. Its concept allocates about 15 hectares to data-centre use within the 25-hectare host property.

locator.precision: Parent-property marker for Circular Park Kyushu, including its existing resource-circulation area. The proposed AI data-centre plot, buildings, entrance, surveyed boundaries and construction extent are not mapped.
locator.identity_review: The prefecture separately identifies the proposed AI facility at Circular Park 1-1 inside CPQ. The city agreement and operator bridge it to the former thermal power station host property. The host official access iframe selects the exact named CPQ Google feature. Its legacy 6110-1 address component is retained as a map-label qualification; the matched named property and official selected map establish identity. The selected feature tuple is not the map viewport.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The selected map feature does not publish surveyed horizontal accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: All fields in 436 sites, 462 projects, 2364 evidence records, 231 original source records and 231 identity mappings were checked against Japanese/English operator, property, city and domain aliases with zero matches. The nearest canonical site is DayOne Imari, 157.9746 km away. Digital Dynamic Iriki/Satsumasendai is a different held project at Iriki industrial estate; it is not this CPQ development. The initial pilot and hypothetical 1 GW regional expansion are not separately admitted.
additions.successor_review: The August 31 Craftia MOU and October 8 city plan support continuing development preparations but do not establish physical works or issued data-centre development consent. Preserve July 18 as the announcement observation, 89 days before the October 15 update. March 2033 remains a forecast. The undated operator 1 GW roadmap is a future concept and does not replace the scoped 350 MW proposal.
